verdict.rationale: Orrick documents a convertible-instrument form, the Convertible Note Financing Term Sheet Creator in Tech Studio. It also states a seed-stage financing practice (Germany and France pages), backed by large VC financing volume and a free library of 50+ forms and 300+ articles. Nothing in the pack mentions SAFEs or pre-seed specifically, and the note form is evidenced only by its title. Missing for 10: any SAFE explainer or form, pre-seed-specific practice statements, substantive content of the convertible note tool, and independent corroboration of the convertible/SAFE work.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm documents deep experience with SAFEs and convertible instruments for pre-seed and seed rounds — published explainers, forms, or a stated early-stage financing practice
